# Rella Aesthetics

> Physician-owned med spa with two clinics in California: Napa (Napa House) and Vacaville. Owned by Zachary Wagner, DO.

## Clinics
- Napa (Napa House): 1541 3rd St, Napa, CA 94559 · Wed-Sat 9 AM-5 PM · (707) 358-2928 · https://experiencerella.com/locations/napa
- Vacaville: 542 Main St, Vacaville, CA 95688 · Tue-Fri 9 AM-5 PM, Sat 9 AM-1 PM · (707) 358-2928 · https://experiencerella.com/locations/vacaville
